entities.summary: Orzala Ashraf Nemat is an Afghan scholar and civil society activist. She established the Women and Youth Leadership Centre in 2012. Orzala got her Phd from School of SOAS, University of London in Law and Political Science. During Afghanistan's Taliban Government she put herself many times directly at risk and launched underground literacy and health education programs for women and girls. Orzala published several articles in greater news sources, like the BBC and the Guardian.
